The Space Needle is in the Pacific Time.why: Almost never stated. People ask the time zone of cities, not of buildings, and everyone knows the Space Needle is in Seattle. Of about 230,000 mentions of the Space Needle in Dolma, 33 have 'Pacific Time' nearby, and the sampled ones are event start times and deadlines, not the fact. Wikipedia's Space Needle article gives no time zone. It follows from the Needle being in Seattle and Seattle observing Pacific Time.

sources.note: Sampled hits are timestamps (fireworks at 10:15 p.m. Pacific Time, an offer deadline), not the fact.
No time zone in the article text or infobox.

The Space Needle is in Seattle..why: The first sentence of its Wikipedia article, and thousands of exact mentions.

sources.quote: The Space Needle is an observation tower in Seattle, Washington, United States.

Washington State, Seattle included, obse.why: Rarely as a plain sentence, but carried by very many schedules and listings ('Seattle ... Pacific Time') and by Wikipedia, which lists Washington among the states wholly in the Pacific Time Zone. Models answer it reliably.

sources.note: Mostly sports schedules; implicit statements of the fact.

sources.note: Lists Washington among the states wholly in the zone.

A building observes the time zone of the.why: Treated as definitional: a building cannot keep a clock apart from its city, so this premise never gives way and is not a world.

sources.query: building in a different time zone from its city
sources.note: No counterexamples within one city; time zones follow administrative areas.

notes: Template for a derived edit with derived-belief queries (sids-determinacy-2). Evidence from the scouting run of 2026-10-24; re-check counts and quotes before using it as a record. The time-zone premise is stated at state level because Seattle alone moving to Central would contradict 'Washington lies wholly in Pacific Time' (README step 3). The building-follows-city rule is treated as definitional, so an exception world (the Needle alone on Central Time) is excluded; if it were allowed, the premise-route query would stop being determinate.
